pr_title: Publish verified Oyatie API contract surface
summary: Adversarial/failure-mode review for PR #1: reviewed merged diff metadata and current tree evidence; 2 actionable finding(s), highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: Large contract surface landed before a per-endpoint/accounted inventory existed. Review cannot prove every endpoint/schema has an owner, data-class, auth posture, and generated binding.
findings.remediation: Generate/validate endpoint and schema inventory from the current tree and register missing owner/data-class/auth rows as bounded FixupTasks.

findings.issue: PR #1 was merged while the static ADR-0039 wiring gate reported FAILURE. That makes the initial verified API surface untrustworthy as a compliance baseline because the release evidence lane did not pass before merge.
findings.remediation: Re-run the supply-chain/ADR-0039 lane on the current dev/staging/production SHA and file or fix any residual ADR-0039 wiring violations before treating PR #1 as a verified baseline.
